facts.text: Snow left Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) 16 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: July 1 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 27 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) and Slide Canyon (9,200 ft).

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: 7.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 54.4 in (2023), 16.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Slide Canyon
evidence.detail: 17.7 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 85.8 in (2023), 36.1 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 25 and May 25, carried from the melt-out dates at Virginia Lakes Ridge (9,400 ft) and Slide Canyon (9,200 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Virginia Lakes Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 1,257 ft above the pass; points to March 19 to May 20

evidence.name: Slide Canyon
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 1,057 ft above the pass; points to April 1 to May 30
